notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup. Started experimenting with Redwood Hosted API last week; dropped in 3 test endpoints. Early impressions: easy to get key & run, but ops/devs raising latency concerns for CA/WA user base. Notes from call:
- Customer quote: "Sometimes the chat freezes and client shows a 5s timeout. Mobile users complain."
- Primary workload: conversational support widget on web + mobile (low concurrency, interactive).
- Reported SLA: want median < 200ms per token for short prompts, and p95 < 1s for streaming initial response. Current observed behavior: some requests to eu-west endpoints hitting 600-900ms first-byte; US-west tests to hosted endpoint show 120-350ms depending on model and prompt size.
- They are fully public-cloud, prefer not to deal with VPC or on-prem. Willing to stay hosted if latency/timeout tuning helps.
Perf tuning discussion (from AE/SE):
- Region choice: recommend spinning up keys/traffic to nearest region (us-west for CA users). Showed them regional perf table (attached).
- Timeout settings: default client timeout was 5s in their frontend. Recommend increasing to 20s for streaming endpoints + set application-level progress indicator. Also recommend server-side token timeout 30s for longer generations.
- Prompt length guidance: encourage trimming system & user instructions; use few-shot examples sparingly. Recommend max_tokens cap 256 for chat starter flows, use summarize-then-expand pattern for long docs.
- Batching/caching: SMB traffic low QPS, batching not useful; enable prefix KV cache for repeat user prompts (suggested cache window 1h for common FAQ).
- Model selection: suggested smaller lower-latency model for interactive widget (gpt-like light variant), fallback to higher-quality model for complex escalations.
- Monitoring: walked them through Redwood Console quick-start: token-level cost, latency per-route, and alerts for p95 regressions.
Open items after call:
- Devs want a short how-to: change region & test latency + recommended client timeout snippets (JS + mobile).
- Need to validate p95 numbers with their synthetic test (we asked for a 200-request trace file).
- Security: they asked about SOC2/SSO setup timeline (SOC2 in place; SSO via SAML documented).
Sales notes / tone: lead warm, pricing sensitivity moderate. Typical SMB budget but will expand to paid as latency/UX issues resolved. Good candidate for self-serve conversion if we can shorten time-to-positive test results.
